name: Promo Snip
summary: A coupon ticket whose stub gets snipped off by scissors and flies into a live basket total
about: A small basket with real quantity steppers and a promo code ticket in mustard and tomato. A valid code flips the stub to show its value, scissors cut along the perforation and the stub flies into the totals while the price rolls down. Wrong, expired and too-small-basket codes each get their own rubber stamp and message.
how: Type a code (letters and numbers), paste one or tap a sample code under the ticket, then press Apply or Enter
A valid code flips the stub, scissors snip it off and it flies into the discount line
The total rolls down to the new price and a You save badge pops up with paper confetti
Change quantities and the discount updates; a code that needs a bigger basket comes off by itself
Unknown or expired codes get a NOT VALID or EXPIRED stamp; the × button removes an applied code
